title: OpenSlope map origin
description: Where a map folder came from, and whether it carries retail bytes. Two separate questions: Origin says who wrote the folder, RetailData says what is inside it. An authored mountain that places a borrowed tree is 'slopesmith' with RetailData set, which is why one boolean would not do. Both producers write this file - `snowknife import` for an extracted course, Slopesmith's export for an authored mountain - and a consumer that finds no Origin.json at all reads the folder as retail rather than as clean.

Origin.description: Who wrote the folder: an extract of a course off a disc, or an authored mountain composed by Slopesmith.

Course.description: The course slot an extract was read from. Absent on an authored mountain.

RetailData.description: Whether the folder contains or references bytes that came off a retail disc. Always true for an extract; true for an authored mountain that borrows art, sound, an effect graph, a sky, or a collision shape.

Reasons.description: Why, in the same vocabulary the Slopesmith export manifest's provenance uses ('retail-texture', 'retail-prop-art', 'retail-sky', ...). An extract carries the single reason 'retail-extract'. Only the retail half travels here - a user-supplied asset is a rights question with a different answer, not a reason to need a copy of the game.

allOf.description: The invariant both directions: retail data is stated with at least one reason, and reasons are listed only when there is retail data.
An extract names the slot it came from; an authored mountain has no slot to name.
